question.text: An 'Indeterminate Trust' is taxed under Section 164 at:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 9.2.1 and Section 164, Indeterminate Trust is taxed at MMR as Trustees are 'representative assessee'. The Trap: Slab/zero/10% are incorrect. Cross-Exam Context: Fundamental trust-taxation principle. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Many Cat III AIFs try to document determinacy carefully to avoid Section 164 MMR.
